texts.facts: This PIL petition is filed on behalf of the petitioner raising a concern about the presence of high percentage formaldehyde in the fish imported into Assam from other States, which is more than the permissible limit. The petitioner has placed reliance on certain news articles published in daily newspapers, namely, "Amar Axom", "Assam Tribune" and has also placed reliance on certain other material in support of the contention that the State Government is not taking any effective measures to check the high percentage of formaldehyde in the fish imported into Assam from other States. In response to the writ petition, a consolidated affidavit is filed by the respondent No.3 on behalf of the State of Assam as well as the Fishery Department, wherein it is stated that to check the high percentage of formaldehyde in the fish imported from the other States, the State Government has prepared an SOP dated 14.11.2023, wherein certain measures have been advised to be adopted for checking the said menace.
texts.arguments: Ms. P. Agarwal, learned counsel for the petitioner has also submitted that if the State Government and its instrumentalities strictly follow the directions given in the SOP, then the high percentage of formaldehyde in the fish imported from the other States can be checked to an extent.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Ms. P.
